summary: 实现 ClaudeDriver 从每轮 kscc --print 改为 Walker 持有的长期 Claude PTY runtime；补齐 attach broker facade，确保真实 attach 输入路径与飞书 prompt 共享同一输入仲裁。

src/drivers/claude-driver.js: new ClaudeDriver({ ptyBroker, attachServer, attachServerFactory, openClaudeAttachTerminal, queueLimit, maxPromptLength, localLeaseTimeoutMs, setTimeout, clearTimeout })
createSession(options) -> pty-attach sessionRef with runtimeId, claudeSessionId, processGeneration, terminal
prompt(sessionRef, text, options) -> writes Buffer.from(text + '\r') to broker.writeInput(runtimeId, ..., { source: 'feishu' }) and returns DONE event
delete(sessionRef) -> broker.deleteRuntime(runtimeId) and clears input arbitration state

attachBroker facade -> getRuntime/resize/subscribeOutput/stopRuntime/deleteRuntime passthrough; writeInput(source:'attach') routes through Driver input arbitration; detach(runtimeId) releases local lease

validation.summary: 19 pass / 0 fail; REQ-003-B02/B04 now exercise attachServer.broker facade writeInput(source:'attach') instead of direct private method calls

red_summary: TDD red: 初次运行 node --test test/claude-driver.test.js 失败，旧 ClaudeDriver 仍返回 cli-terminal、prompt 仍 spawn --print，且缺少 _handleAttachInput/_acquireLocalLease/_setRuntimeBusy 等输入仲裁接口。Reviewer 修复 red: 真实 attach server 持有原始 ptyBroker 时会绕过 Driver 输入仲裁，原 B02/B04 测试仅直接调用私有方法。
known_risks: T3 仅返回 prompt submitted DONE 事件；精确 Claude JSONL 轮次观察由 T4 接入。
busy/permission 状态目前通过内部状态切换接口驱动；真实 TUI 输出解析与状态识别由后续观察/集成任务接入。
默认不自动启动 attach server；若注入 attachServer 或 attachServerFactory，Driver 会提供 attachBroker facade。T2 当前不会自动调用 detach hook，但 facade 已提供 detach(runtimeId) 并由 T3 测试覆盖。
notes: Reviewer 修复: attachServer.broker 被强制替换为 driver.attachBroker facade，避免真实 attach writeInput(source:'attach') 直接写原始 ptyBroker。
Reviewer 修复: facade.writeInput(source:'attach') 调用 _handleAttachInput，由 Driver 建立/释放 local lease，再写原始 ptyBroker，避免递归。
Reviewer 修复: REQ-003-B02/B04 测试改为经 attachServer.broker.writeInput(source:'attach') 和 attachServer.broker.detach(runtimeId) 验证真实 attach 入口。
